scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT outputs is infeasible because the checker cannot re-run DFT. The agent reports extracted Löwdin populations and computed formation energies. We verify structural ordering and compare numerical values against paper-reported gold (NM2 column) with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Löwdin populations and formation energies from paper Table 2 (NM2 column) and eq (1),(2)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Table 2 NM2 column and reported E_vf1=0.92 eV, E_vf2=1.32 eV in section 3.3
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct reading from the paper; values hardcoded inline in grading_spec_json for checker use.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are extracted from the published paper and serve as the gold standard for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Löwdin total atomic populations (in electrons) for the nonmagnetic (NM2) case of SrFeO3 and SrFeO2.875. The file contains a block for SrFeO3 with rows Fe, Sr, O, and a block for SrFeO2.875 with rows Fe1, Fe2, Fe3, Sr1, Sr2, O1–O7.
Oxygen vacancy formation energies E_vf1 (uncorrected GGA) and E_vf2 (corrected GGA+U) for the nonmagnetic (NM2) case, both in eV.

output_contract.notes: All DFT calculations use the nonmagnetic configuration (NM2). The agent must perform the full pipeline to obtain the required total energies; no pre-computed data is provided.
